instruction: According to fishbase.org, what is the FishBase Name and species of every fish in Japan that has a highly commercial designation in both the "use" column and the "use elsewhere" column?

task_metadata.problem: According to fishbase.org, what is the FishBase Name and species of every fish in Japan that has a highly commercial designation in both the "use" column and the "use elsewhere" column?
task_metadata.answer: Pacific sandlance (Ammodytes personatus), Japanese Scad (Decapterus maruadsi), Japanese anchovy (Engraulis japonicus), Deepwater longtail red snapper (Etelis coruscans), Alaska pollack (Gadus chalcogrammus), Pacific cod (Gadus macrocephalus), Red seabream (Pagrus major), Ayu sweetfish (Plecoglossus altivelis), Chub mackerel (Scomber japonicus), Japanese amberjack (Seriola quinqueradiata), Japanese pufferfish (Takifugu rubripes), Yellowfin tuna (Thunnus albacares)
